title: Bear Spray
description: A new weapon: a cone of orange spray in front of you that knocks bears back and strips a grizzly's shield in one hit (grizzlies ended 27.4% of Build #14's runs).

title: Bull Trap
description: From 4:00, a fat gold candle sits on the floor; grab it and the floor snaps shut: a ring of red candles closes in around you, and clearing it pays double XP.

title: Thick Hide
description: The bull's own edge: 120 HP instead of 100, and every Horns swing shoves bears back a step (the bull's median run was 3:13, Pepe's 8:07).
